verdict.rationale: React's official docs embed an editable sandbox that needs no installation, and they provide a hands-on tic-tac-toe tutorial for beginners with no prior React knowledge. Together these deliver browser-based, setup-free hands-on learning. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the tic-tac-toe tutorial itself runs step-by-step in the browser sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-browser learning experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can try an in-browser interactive tutorial to learn the framework hands-on without any local setup

citations.quote: You don't need to install anything to play with React. Try editing this sandbox!
You will build a small tic-tac-toe game during this tutorial. This tutorial does not assume any existing React knowledge.
